name: CM30_resources_are_bounded
origins: user requirement 2026-10-21 (do not crash my mac)
statement: Heavy subprocesses take machine-wide slots (at most CARDMODEL_MAX_PARALLEL across every cardmodel process), run at lower priority in their own process group, and are killed when the group passes its memory cap; this process stops itself (MemoryBudget) past its own cap; the interpreter caps integer size. A run never takes the machine down.
